messages:
Tara: Quick thread 11 planning a short experiment to tweak healthscore decay for dormant accounts. Want to test reducing decay rate from 0.12/month -> 0.06/month in the CS sandbox to see how playbook triggers change. Who can run analytics preview? :bar_chart:

Ben: I can run the preview. Proposed dataset: cs_analytics.sandbox_health_preview. We'll apply decay param override and compute health_delta for accounts with last_touch 30-90d. Sample 1k accounts.

Sofi: Important: ensure we don't change canonical score. Use `health_score_preview` column and mark `visibility = 'cs_ui'`. Also exclude accounts with pending renewals and accounts in active escalations.

Marco: Playbooks affected: owner-touch, renewal-nudge, and churn-safety. We'll simulate triggers and show which accounts would flip buckets. Add a column `would_trigger_owner_nudge` boolean in preview.

Ben: SQL I'll run (preview):
```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT account_id, health_score, last_touch_at
  FROM cs_analytics.account_scores
  WHERE last_touch_at BETWEEN now() - interval '90 days' AND now() - interval '30 days'
  LIMIT 1000
), preview AS (
  SELECT account_id, health_score, 
    health_score * exp(-0.06 * age_in_months(last_touch_at)) AS health_preview
  FROM base
)
SELECT p.account_id, base.health_score, p.health_preview, 
  CASE WHEN p.health_preview < 40 THEN true ELSE false END AS would_trigger_owner_nudge
FROM preview p
JOIN base ON base.account_id = p.account_id;
```

Tara: Nice. Ops: can you confirm the preview pipeline won1t leak to reporting or billing?

ops-bot: Note: preview dataset `cs_analytics.sandbox_health_preview` is tagged `env:sandbox` and excluded from billing/export pipelines by current retention rules.

Sofi: Also: compare downstream playbook volume delta. If owner-nudge increases >5% we might need to add rate-limits. We should simulate notifications per owner and cap at +2/day.

Marco: Add a column `owner_notification_delta` in the result so product can see who will get extra nudges. Also flag owners with >30 additional notifications for manual review.

Ben: Uploaded results to /shared/cs/health-decay/previews/preview_4860000123.csv and pushed a small dashboard to the sandbox. Link sent in DM.

Tara: Reviewing: preliminary looks like ~4% of accounts cross the owner-nudge threshold, mostly with last_touch 45-60d. Good. Any concerns about false positives?

Sofi: One concern: accounts with multiple contacts had inflated last_touch; preview shows some will drop more than expected. Add a filter to only include accounts with effective_contact_count > 0.

Marco: Also check playbook choreography: if owner-nudge and renewal-nudge both fire, ensure dedupe rule picks renewal-nudge with higher priority. Add `resolved_nudge = coalesce(renewal_nudge, owner_nudge)` logic in preview.

ops-bot: scheduled: manual review meeting set for 2026-08-12T17:00:00Z in #customer-success by Tara

Tara: Next steps: 1) run second pass with additional filters Sofi suggested, 2) validate owner notification delta, 3) if delta <=5% run a 1-week canary on sandbox UI only (no canonical changes). I'll post results and a short runbook snippet. :white_check_mark:
